description: Ask a notebook a question; the answer comes from its documents, with sources. Waits up to 25 seconds for the answer, otherwise returns the query_job_id for get_knowledge_answer. Without chat_session_id a new conversation starts.

app_id.description: Optional app whose notebooks to use. Omitted: the owner's own Business Brain.

source_ids.description: Optional: answer only from these documents.

name: ask_knowledge_notebook
title: Ask Knowledge Notebook
